newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan petrochemical shares up on price hikes.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan petrochemical shares up on price hikes.

text.p: Overseas price hikes for styrene monomer pulled Taiwan petrochemical share prices higher in active early trade on Monday and brokers expected the sector to maintain their strength in the near term.
After 45 minutes, Grand Petrochemical was the most actively traded issue, jumping T$1.6 or 6.13 percent to T$27.7. Taiwan Styrene Monomer shot up the daily seven percent limit to T$34.2.
The weighted index gained only 0.40 percent to 6,916.57.
"The petrochemical sector has been slow for quite a long time with not much buying interest and no inspiring news," said Oliver Fang, analyst of National Secutities.
"The overseas price hikes came out in time for a rebound in petrochemicals," he said.
Brokers cautioned that they did not expect the petrochemical sector's strength to boost the overall market, as wider sentiment remained cautious below the psychological barrier at 7,000 points.
